arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE transparent full-body cartoon sprite based on the FIRST image, an exact enlarged pixel-art pose. The SECOND image is ONLY the shared character identity/material/style reference, NOT its walking pose. Keep the source's exact facing, head angle, arm/hand positions and standing leg/foot silhouette. Same adult small worker: black cap, dark short hair, tan face/hands, bright green long-sleeve shirt, royal blue bib overalls, dark shoes; crisp black contour and clean cel shading, rounded natural anatomy. Do not trace pixel stairs. The standing feet/legs from the FIRST image must remain in their source stance, not the key's raised knee. Keep both hands and both feet. Match occlusion of head/arms rather than moving hands for visibility. True transparent RGBA background, no scenery, floor, shadows, halos, extra objects, text or duplicate figure. Leave about 5% transparent safety margin outside all contours.  Exactly TWO arms total, one left and one right, and exactly TWO hands total. Standing worker, head facing SCREEN-RIGHT with one visible eye, eyebrow, nose and mouth. Both arms raised overhead in an asymmetric tall U. The SCREEN-LEFT arm bends outward at the elbow and returns upward with hand angled slightly inward; the SCREEN-RIGHT arm extends higher and more vertically, with its hand at the top bending slightly inward. Keep the original generous gap above the cap and unequal arm bends, two separate hands. Two straight legs, both distinct offset shoes pointing right. No extra lowered arms.
